A '''cut copper stairs''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds [[Crafting Table]] recipes for the 3 variants below, and otherwise leaves them as in vanilla. See {{MCW|Cut Copper Stairs}} for everything else.
